name: Signal Strength
source:
A bunch of annoying lesbians on an agricultural research station get really into public television when a distant war isolates them from the rest of the Federation, with surprising results.

[From [url=https://birdwrongs.itch.io/signal-strength]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当一场遥远的战争将她们与联邦其他成员隔离开来时，农业研究站的一群烦人的女同性恋者真正进入了公共电视，并带来了令人惊讶的结果。

[来自[url=https://birdwrongs.itch.io/signal-strength]Itch.io[/url]]
